p: Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of bumper plates, a set of thick solid rubber weight plates of equal 450 mm diameter but different widths, with steel centre hubs, stacked upright on a simple plate rack, coloured red, blue, yellow, green and black.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A safety squat bar, a thick padded barbell with a cambered centre that sits on the shoulders, a padded yoke wrapped around the neck section and two handles projecting forwards and down from the pad, with the sleeves angled slightly downwards.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A bamboo / earthquake bar, a flexible bamboo or fibreglass bar about 2 m long, with kettlebells hanging from elastic bands looped around each end so the load swings and oscillates.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of chains, a pair of heavy steel link chains, each draped over a thinner loading chain, hanging from both sleeves of a barbell so the links pile on the floor.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A monolift, a heavy two-post squat stand with hooks on swinging arms that hold the bar then pivot out of the way, a foot-operated lever cam at the base and long safety arms projecting forward.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An angled Smith machine, a Smith machine whose twin guide rods lean backwards at a slight angle of about 7 degrees, with a counterweighted barbell on the rails, rotating hooks and plate pegs, and safety stops at the base.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A decline bench, a padded bench angled head-down at about 20 degrees with a padded leg hook roller at the raised end to lock the legs in and a small pair of bar uprights at the low end.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A preacher bench, a seat in front of an angled padded arm rest sloping down and away from the user, with a pair of bar catches at the base of the pad to rest an EZ bar.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of pulling / jerk blocks, a pair of stacked wooden or foam cubes of adjustable height, placed under each end of a loaded barbell so the bar sits off the floor at knee height.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of dumbbells, a two-tier rack holding a row of pairs of fixed round rubber-ended dumbbells with knurled chrome handles, increasing in size along the row.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An adjustable kettlebell, a kettlebell made of a handle and core that accepts stacked weight plates locked into its base, with a selector dial or locking pin.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An adjustable pulley (any height), a single tall steel tower with a weight stack and a pulley carriage that slides up and down a vertical rail with a pop-pin to set any height, a D-handle clipped to the cable.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A functional trainer, a compact steel frame with two weight stacks side by side and a pair of swinging pulley arms that slide up and down vertical columns on each side, with multi-grip pull-up handles on the top crossbar.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A straight cable bar, a short knurled chrome bar about 50 cm long with a swivel mount and a clip ring in the centre for connecting to a cable.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A lat bar, a long chrome bar about 120 cm wide with ends bent downwards and outwards and rubber grips, with a central swivel clip ring.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A multi-station cable jungle, a large central steel frame with four weight stacks arranged around it, each feeding a different station: a lat pulldown seat, a low row bench, a high and low adjustable pulley and a crossover arm.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A decline sit-up bench, a padded bench angled head-down with an adjustable height and foot rollers at the raised end to lock the feet.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An incline trainer, a motorised treadmill that tilts steeply upwards to a 30 to 40 percent incline, with a long belt, front handles and a large touchscreen console.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A BikeErg, an upright bike with an air-resistance flywheel enclosed in a fan cage at the front, a saddle, pedals and adjustable handlebars.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A spin bike, an indoor cycling bike with a heavy exposed flywheel at the front, a narrow saddle, drop handlebars and a resistance knob.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An arc trainer, a cardio machine with two long foot pedals on arms that travel along a curved arc track from a low rear pivot, moving handles in front linked to the pedals and a raised console on a central upright.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A VersaClimber, a tall vertical mast about 2.5 m high angled slightly forwards, with two foot pedals at the base and two hand grips higher up that slide up and down alternately, and a small display.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A sled / prowler, a steel sled with flat runners, two vertical push poles of different heights, a central loading post for plates and a tow ring for a rope.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A rope pull machine, a tall vertical steel frame with an endless thick rope that loops around a pulley at the top and runs through a resistance unit at the bottom, with a seat or standing platform in front.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A medicine ball, a round rubber ball about the size of a football with a grippy textured dimpled surface, resting on a gym floor beside two smaller ones.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A sledgehammer, a long wooden or steel-shafted hammer about 90 cm long with a heavy flat-faced steel head, leaning against a large tractor tyre lying flat on the floor.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A resisted sprint harness, a padded waist belt with a long nylon tether running behind to a trailing fabric parachute or to a partner's hand loop, laid out on a running track.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A yoke, a tall rectangular steel frame with two vertical uprights and a padded crossbar at shoulder height, loading horns on the lower legs and a flat base, so the user stands under the crossbar and lifts it.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A Husafell stone, a large flat triangular slab of stone or a cast steel equivalent shaped like a thick arrowhead, about 60 cm tall, lying flat on rubber flooring.
Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A keg, a steel beer keg with two built-in side handles, weighted with sand or water, standing upright on the floor.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A car deadlift frame, a long steel lever frame with two parallel handles at one end at knee height and plate loading horns at the other end, pivoting on a raised fulcrum near the middle.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of gymnastic rings, a pair of smooth wooden rings about 23 cm across, hanging side by side from long black webbing straps with cam buckles from an overhead beam.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of resistance bands, a set of long flat looped latex bands of different colours and widths, coiled on the floor and one hooked over a steel peg at the base of a rack.
Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A stability ball, a large smooth inflated PVC ball about 65 cm across, resting on a gym floor.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A pegboard, a tall rectangular wooden board fixed vertically to a wall, with two columns of round holes running up its length and two wooden pegs sitting in holes near the bottom.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A neck harness, a leather or nylon head harness with straps that go over the top and around the back of the head, joined by a short chain with a carabiner for hanging weight plates.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of monkey bars, a horizontal steel ladder raised about 2.2 m off the ground on two A-frame supports at each end, with evenly spaced round rungs.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An exercise / yoga mat, a thin rectangular rubber exercise mat about 180 cm long, partly rolled up at one end, lying flat on a wooden floor.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A slant board, a flat wooden board about 40 cm wide raised at the back to a steep incline of 20 to 30 degrees on fixed legs, with grip tape covering the top surface.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An inversion table, a tall A-shaped steel frame with a padded backrest on a central pivot, ankle locking rollers at the bottom and handles at the sides, tilted head-down.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A rehab leg press / jump trainer, a long low frame on which the user lies on their back on a sliding padded carriage, pushing against a large flat footplate in front, with resistance cords underneath.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A shoulder pulley / wheel, a wall-mounted wheel with a rotating handle on its rim and an adjustable arm, beside an over-door pulley with a rope running through and two handles on its ends.
